skill.summary: Automatically detects and repairs errors in AI agent workflows

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release introducing automatic error detection and self-repair for AI agents:

- Detects agent workflow failures and diagnoses root causes.
- Auto-applies high-confidence fixes based on a database of 12 built-in error patterns.
- Supports learning new fix patterns from user input.
- Includes commands for diagnosis, healing, pattern management, and monitoring.
- Provides safety features to avoid destructive fixes.
- Integrates with OpenClaw for easy error analysis and recovery.
